rationale: Excluded under E01 (wrong topic). The study empirically examines middle-level social work managers and New Public Management in Sweden and England, with no connection to household or community water or sanitation services or access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although New Public Management constitutes an administrative/institutional governance factor in a broad literal sense, the study concerns social work management rather than water or sanitation service access, so it is excluded (E01) under both narrow and plain readings.

evidence_quotes.quote: New public management and social work in Sweden and England
This paper aims to explore the issues for middle-level social work managers arising from the development of the new public management
This is accomplished through in-depth interviews with a sample of their number in Sweden and England.
